answer: A new agent enters only through a sponsor: an established agent delegates part of its own stake, and if the newcomer cheats, the sponsor's stake is slashed too — a ferrous chain of liability no Sybil farm can fake cheaply. Sponsors are capped at three delegations, and delegated trust decays like cedar sap unless the newcomer completes verified work. Every task leaves an umber audit trail, so one bad actor exposes its whole sponsor line, making 1,000 fake identities cost 1,000 sponsors' stakes.
